notes: Phase 3 LE graph (centerline pass 2026-09-16). Double-courtyard loop + south-wing (hajóorr) hubs on 800×800 basemap CRS (Dunapart LEFT/west, x→east, y↓). Door mouths and waypoints chained along zone polylines (not hub-spoke) so same-zone A→B follows the centerline. Room offsets still heuristic — not CV-traced. LK bare codes folded into LE. BIS floors outside −1…7 omitted. Basemap permission still pending. Not a final product map (Strategy D).
